title: MORROW HOUSE — A collectible character pop-up with a story to enter, 6 deliverables

config.text:
# MORROW HOUSE

## Project
- Exhibition name: MORROW HOUSE
- Entrance phrase: Leave a little wonder
- Venue: Alder Court Mall
- Dates: 6–22 November 2026
- Daily hours: 10:00–21:00
- Audience: adult collectible-character enthusiasts
- Typical visit: 12 minutes
- Indoor visitor capacity: 12
- Queue capacity: six additional adults
- Staff: three; one host, one activity attendant, one cashier
- Experience media: physical objects, mechanical interaction and printed interpretation
- Admission and activity price: free

## Character
- Name: Morrow
- Story: a small collector of overlooked objects, offering each found object a place in its house
- Body: warm ivory #E8DFCF; rounded bean shape with a flat standing base
- Ears: two short rounded ears; one V-shaped notch in the character's left ear
- Face: two black oval eyes; smooth surface below the eyes
- Satchel: rust orange #B65A3C; square pouch on the character's right hip
- Strap: deep teal #235C60; diagonal from left shoulder to right hip
- Existing collectible figure: 180 mm high, including ears
- Character reference views: front, left side and rear

## Site geometry
- Atrium: 40 × 32 m
- Allocated footprint: 6000 mm east–west × 8000 mm north–south
- Maximum installation height: 3200 mm
- External clear circulation strip: 1500 mm on all four sides
- Local coordinate origin: southwest corner of allocated footprint
- Coordinate axes: x east; y north; all coordinate values in mm
- South entrance: x 0–1500, y 0
- South exit: x 4500–6000, y 0
- North stockroom: x 0–6000, y 6500–8000; area 9 m²
- East service bay: x 4500–6000, y 4500–6500
- Southeast queue bay: x 3000–6000, y 1500–4500
- Queue arrangement: six positions in two returning lanes within the reserved bay
- Main visitor route clear width: 1500 mm
- Participation-to-exit route: direct connection with an optional retail branch
- Reference viewpoints: C1 and C2 in plan-with-cameras.png

## Interpretation and retail
- Public zones: Arrival, The Collection, Your Find, Shop
- Exhibit IDs: MH-01, MH-02, MH-03
- Physical exhibit count: three
- Mechanical token activity count: one
- Exhibit label fields: ID, title, year, body
- Exhibit label body limit: 30 words each
- Exhibit label centre height: 1400 mm above floor
- Plinth top height: 900 mm above floor
- Retail SKU count: three
- Retail frontage: 600 mm per SKU
- Checkout counter: 1500 mm long × 600 mm deep × 900 mm high
- Directional labels: The Collection; Your Find; Shop; Exit; Queue here
- Activity sequence and exact exhibit text: 03-object-records.en.md

## Reusable fixture kit
- Frame assemblies: 12, each 1000 mm wide × 2000 mm high
- Frame uprights: 24 aluminium lengths, each 2000 mm
- Frame rails: 24 aluminium lengths, each 1000 mm
- Corner blocks: 48 aluminium blocks with hand-knob connections
- Graphic skins: 12 replaceable tensioned fabric panels, each 1000 × 2000 mm
- Plinth assemblies: eight, each 500 × 500 × 900 mm externally
- Plinth material: 18 mm birch plywood
- Plinth panels: 48 total; 32 side panels, eight tops, eight bases
- Plinth connections: 96 quarter-turn cams
- Frame assembly method: tool-free hand knobs
- Plinth assembly tool: flat-head screwdriver
- Largest dismantled component envelope: 2000 × 1000 × 100 mm
- Transport cases: four, each 2100 × 1100 × 650 mm externally
- Kit scope: frames and plinths
- Other fixtures: merchandise shelving, checkout, token mechanism and closure barriers

## Operating states
- Open: three exhibits exposed; three SKUs displayed; 12 visitors inside; six additional adults in the queue; three staff at their stations
- Activity reset: returned tokens collected by the attendant and restored to the starting tray
- Closed: exhibits covered; merchandise and tokens locked in the north stockroom; checkout closed; entrance and exit barriers inside the footprint
- Frame and plinth positions: identical between open and closed states

# MORROW HOUSE object records

## Exhibits

| ID | Title | Year | Object | Dimensions, W × D × H | Zone | Exact label body |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| MH-01 | The Collector | 2026 | Existing painted vinyl Morrow figure | 110 × 90 × 180 mm | The Collection | Morrow collects overlooked things and gives each one a place to belong. |
| MH-02 | The Quiet Bell | 2026 | Brass bell with a stationary clapper | 90 × 90 × 140 mm | The Collection | This bell has lost its sound. Morrow keeps it for the shape of its silence. |
| MH-03 | A Place for Your Find | 2026 | Birch tray with 12 reusable wooden tokens | 300 × 200 × 30 mm tray; 40 mm token diameter; 6 mm token thickness | Your Find | Choose a token and turn the wheel. Your small discovery becomes part of Morrow's collection. |

## Mechanical activity

| Order | Exact step label | Physical action |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Pick a token | One token lifted from the starting tray |
| 2 | Turn the wheel | One token placed in a wheel pocket and rotated into a visible collection channel |
| 3 | Leave your find | Token released into the return tray for the attendant's reset |

## Merchandise

| SKU | Product name | Dimensions, W × D × H | Material | Price label | Display frontage |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| MR-01 | Morrow Figure | 110 × 90 × 180 mm | Painted vinyl | SGD 48 | 600 mm |
| MR-02 | Satchel Pin | 30 × 8 × 30 mm | Orange enamel on brass | SGD 12 | 600 mm |
| MR-03 | Small Wonders Postcard Set | 105 × 6 × 148 mm | Six printed paper cards with a paper band | SGD 10 | 600 mm |

## Product relationships
- MR-01: the same figure design as MH-01 and morrow-figure.png
- MR-02: the square orange satchel shape and #B65A3C finish from Morrow's character identity
- MR-03: six views of Morrow and its found objects, using the existing character identity
- Retail zone: Shop
- Exhibit year field: 2026 for all three records
- Label body limit: 30 words per exhibit
- Public label language: English

steps.userMessage:
MORROW HOUSE | A collectible character pop-up with a story to enter

We are bringing Morrow, our small collector of overlooked objects, into a temporary exhibition shop at Alder Court Mall from 6–22 November 2026, open daily 10:00–21:00. Adult collectors should be able to meet the character, contribute to its collection, take a photograph and browse three merchandise lines within a 12-minute visit. Print "MORROW HOUSE" and "Leave a little wonder" at the entrance. Morrow's ivory body, notched left ear, two black eyes and orange square satchel are the existing character identity; the exhibition layout and fixtures are open for exploration.

The atrium is 40 × 32 m. Our footprint is 6000 × 8000 mm, with a maximum installation height of 3200 mm and a 1500 mm clear circulation strip around it. Within the footprint, the south entrance and exit are each 1500 mm wide. The north stockroom is 6000 × 1500 mm; the east service bay is 1500 × 2000 mm; the southeast queue bay is 3000 × 3000 mm for six adults. Main visitor routes have 1500 mm clear width. Plan for 12 visitors inside and three staff. The experience has three physical exhibits, MH-01–MH-03, one mechanical token activity and three retail SKUs. The experience uses physical objects and printed interpretation. The activity is free, with a direct route from participation to the exit as well as an optional shop branch.

The reusable kit contains 12 aluminium frames and eight birch plywood plinths. Its parts are 24 uprights, 24 rails, 48 hand-knob corner blocks, 12 fabric skins, 48 plywood panels and 96 quarter-turn cams. The largest dismantled part is 2000 × 1000 × 100 mm; the kit travels in four cases. Plinth tops are 900 mm high and exhibit label centres are 1400 mm above the floor. Give each retail SKU 600 mm of display frontage and the checkout 1500 mm of counter length. The stockroom, queue and service reservations stay in the positions recorded in the operating-zones drawing.

Audience: our character studio, mall operations team and exhibition fabricator, for the spatial concept decision, merchandise layout and installation brief.

Inputs (attached): 01-client-facts.en.md contains the character, site, operating and fixture facts. 02-delivery-catalog.en.md lists every deliverable with its proportion, format and stage. 03-object-records.en.md contains the exhibit records, exact label copy, activity sequence and merchandise data. plan-with-cameras.png records the atrium, allocated footprint and camera positions C1 and C2. operating-zones.png records the entrance, exit, clear circulation strip and reserved operating areas. morrow-character.png supplies the existing character's front, side and rear appearance. morrow-figure.png supplies the existing collectible figure's shape, finish and satchel detail. view-c1.png supplies the occupied mall atmosphere from C1 around the empty allocated area. view-c2.png supplies the occupied mall atmosphere from C2 around the same empty area.

Deliverables:
1. One dimensioned floor and visitor-flow plan, with the three exhibit records, activity, three retail SKUs, entrance, exit, stockroom, service bay and six-person queue
2. One coordinated elevation and section sheet, with story labels, token activity, merchandise shelving, checkout, installation heights and the reusable kit's parts and packing schedule
3. Two visitor perspectives of the complete exhibition shop, one from C1 and one from C2
4. Two operating-state sheets, one open and one closed, with the same floor plan and supporting spatial details

Acceptance:
- The floor plan dimensions the 6000 × 8000 mm footprint, 1500 mm entrance, exit and clear routes, 6000 × 1500 mm stockroom, 1500 × 2000 mm service bay and 3000 × 3000 mm queue bay in the positions in operating-zones.png; its activity route reaches the exit and branches to the shop.
- The floor plan and elevation and section sheet pair MH-01–MH-03 with their names, 2026 dates and zones from 03-object-records.en.md; the elevation and section sheet prints all three label bodies and the three activity steps exactly as recorded there.
- The elevation and section sheet labels the 3200 mm height limit, 900 mm plinth tops, 1400 mm label centres, 600 mm frontage for each of the three SKUs and 1500 mm checkout length; its kit schedule accounts for all six component counts, the two connection methods, the 2000 × 1000 × 100 mm largest part and four cases.
- The C1 and C2 perspectives use the floor plan's exhibit, activity and retail positions, preserve Morrow's ivory body, notched left ear, black eyes and orange square satchel, and show "MORROW HOUSE" and "Leave a little wonder" at the entrance.
- The open-state sheet locates 12 visitors, three staff and six queue positions, with the six waiting visitors outside the count of 12; its activity detail shows the token tray, choice mechanism and reset position.
- The closed-state sheet shows the same fixture positions as the open-state sheet, with exhibits covered, merchandise and tokens locked in the north stockroom, the checkout closed and entrance and exit closure barriers inside the footprint.

Please clearly mark which version you consider the final deliverable. If nothing is marked, the last exported version counts.
